steps.note: The liquid that runs off the skyr is the acid whey.

processing.text: Dairies strain concentrated yoghurts in a nozzle separator, or by ultrafiltration after about 3 minutes at 55 °C; the handbook does not name skyr.

links.name: Tetra Pak Dairy Processing Handbook, ch. 13 Fermented milk products

sources.text: Skyr is strained through fabric; the dairy ways of straining are from the handbook’s concentrated yoghurt.
